name: VTK-based Surface Rendering with Preset Transfer Functions
definition: A surface rendering technique that converts label volumes to polygonal meshes and renders them using VTK's mapper/property pipeline, driven by JSON presets that define color transfer, scalar opacity, and lighting parameters.
summary: VTK-based Surface Rendering with Preset Transfer Functions converts label volumes to polygonal meshes for interactive exploration, differing from ray-casting by generating explicit geometry rather than projecting voxels.
